name: First Draw
audience: New players comparing Magic: The Gathering, Pokémon TCG and Elestrals and choosing a friendly first step.
promise: Find your game. Make your first move.
headline: Find your game. Make your first move.
summary: Curious about trading card games? Explore three worlds, learn where to begin, and take your first turn with a little guidance.
design_direction: An illustrated field guide: snowy white space, deep navy type and cyan details. The learner's character welcomes newcomers; clear first steps take priority over competitive jargon.
